name: R$ is not $ — a BRL amount must never be read as USD
query: um equipamento de R$8M no Brasil
note: Incident (fixed 2026-09-08): 'R$8M' was read as USD 8,000,000. A currency the parser cannot convert is UNSTATED, not eight million dollars — reading it as USD applied a size hard-exclude that removed exactly the lenders who could write an ~R$8M (≈USD 1.5M) deal, while keeping lenders whose floor is above it. Blank means unknown, never guessed into a filter. Size must stay null until the deal states a USD figure; the Brazil geography and the international requirement still stand.
